== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Sword [[madra]] is a specialized form of energy used by practitioners on the [[Path of the Endless Sword]]. It can be utilized to strengthen physical weapons or manifested into various combat forms. Through techniques such as [[Enforcement]], a user can pour [[madra]] into a blade to gather aura, causing the weapon to grow more powerful as it moves. This energy can be shaped into diverse offensive maneuvers, including crescent-shaped waves known as [[Rippling Sword]] or massive, translucent replicas of a weapon called a [[Final Sword]]. Beyond enhancing existing blades, sword [[madra]] can be [[Forged]] into entirely new structures. This includes creating razor-thin edges, dense limbs that function like [[steel]], or even multiple floating arms used for combat. It can also be condensed into specialized constructs such as crystals, spikes, or long-lasting bars of energy. When combined with other elements like [[soulfire]], [[blood madra]], or ice, it creates complex combat effects. While highly effective for cutting and shredding, the strength of sword [[madra]] can be influenced by the user's current state or the specific techniques they employ, such as the [[Flowing Sword]].}}
